shortPlayName: The Dragon God Wakes for His Daughter
summary:
The mightiest Dragon God, Vaelor ruled the skies. To keep his daughter Arya from the dragon bloodline's conflicts, he gave up his power and hid as a humble blacksmith.
Arya was all he had after his wife died. Trusting a royal family he had saved, he gave her to them—who destroyed her. Crown Prince Cassian abused her as a mere vessel of the dragon bloodline.
Fearing her father would destroy the kingdom, Arya hid her pain with a smile; seeing her injuries, he restrained his rage.
Until her wedding day, when he arrived to see those she trusted push her to despair. Discovering her dragon blood, Cassian tried to steal her power; cornered, Arya fell from the tower, awakening her dragon blood in death. He found only her body—and the Dragon God returned.
They had killed not an ordinary girl but a god's only daughter. He vowed to make them pay and reclaim his gift to humanity—yet he wanted more: his daughter back. Redemption teaches him true power lies in protecting those he loves.

shortPlayName: The Vampire King I Was Born To Kill
summary:
Five centuries ago, humanity forged an eternal pact with vampires, creating three forces: the Bloodline Crown, the Dawn Guardians, the Hunters. The Council imprisoned them. Ava Bennett, the last Guardian, storms the palace to kill King Damon Black.

Damon knew her yet offers a deal: stay and learn the truth about him. He is no monster but the Council's 300-year prisoner on a hated throne. Enemies become allies.

Hunter Ryan Cole tracks them, questioning his mission; Lucius's rebellion unites the trio, and Damon dissolves the pact, toppling Lucius.

Victory is brief: Lucius sacrifices himself to the Eternal Night, unleashing war. Damon is corrupted; Ava seals it with her Dawn Eye, losing her sight. Lucius's last humanity closes the breach.

Ava amends the pact; Ryan guards the door. A year later the artifact restores her Eye, revealing beyond the door an ancient consciousness older than vampires or humans. She opens it, sees a beautiful world, but Damon is gone—so she closes it.

shortPlayName: I Married the Man Who Buried His Brides
summary:
On her wedding day, Erin was forced by her foster mother to marry Seville, rumored to have buried three brides. Her cousin Viola bet she would die within seven days, wearing her funeral dress; Erin tore it up and found a fourth tombstone in the rose garden—her name and death date seven days away.

Seville barred her from the West Tower and mute Lucy, who called her "Mom."

The tombs held only dresses and rings with her fingerprints. The files revealed the three brides were all her, her identity reset three times; Seville signed to save her yet took her three lives.

Erin didn't forgive him: she faked a fourth erasure and forced the villain to verify her, triggering a review that proved their theft.

Exposed, Adrian fled into the tomb with Lucy. Erin sealed the exit, locking him in the tomb meant for her, then took the estate, tore up the contract and gave Seville an unnamed ring: "For the fourth time, I can choose to remember you—but you must chase me again."

summary:
Molly Hart runs a street food truck called Big Molly’s Hot Dogs with her adoptive parents. People love to joke about the name—and about Molly herself—but she never lets it get to her. If anything, she turns it into part of the brand.
Meanwhile, Adrian Blackwood, heir to the Blackwood empire, has gone days without being able to eat. The best doctors, private chefs, and nutritionists money can buy have all failed to help him.
Then Charles brings one of Molly’s hot dogs back to the estate. What was meant to be a simple meal unexpectedly catches Adrian’s attention. For the first time in days, he willingly takes a bite—and his condition immediately begins to improve.
The moment Adrian learns the hot dog came from a food-truck girl named Molly Hart, he sets out to find her.
Neither of them expects that a relationship beginning with food, money, and a very unusual arrangement will eventually turn into something neither can walk away from: real dependence, real desire, and real love.

summary: Twenty years after the Battle of the World Tree, former Dragon God Nidhogg abandons his divinity and hides in Skyfire City to live a quiet life with his daughter Fennica. Fennica is forced into an arranged marriage with Joss, who covets her pure dragon bloodline. He repeatedly drains her blood and threatens to kill her father to silence her. On their wedding day, Joss siphons all her dragon blood, leaving her trapped in a deathlike slumber. Nidhogg’s long-suppressed rage erupts. He drops his disguise as a humble restaurant owner, summons his dragon army, and embarks on a path of vengeance. He eliminates all who harmed his daughter, uncovers the huge conspiracy behind the World Tree War orchestrated by the Church and Blood Clan, and fights tirelessly to restore Fennica’s blood power and wake her from endless sleep.

Vivian Mercer had been married to Grant for ten years. She ran the household and helped her husband build his business in its early days. However, during the divorce trial, Grant, his mistress and her in-laws conspired to leave her penniless, even taking their son Leo away from her. Grant humiliated her in court, sneering that she had no money, job or home to raise a child. Vivian lifted her head and retorted: “Then I’ll buy the company that pays your lawyer.”
Though she seemed on the verge of breaking down, she actually possessed evidence of financial fraud and illegal asset transfers committed by Grant’s company. She reclaimed control of the trust fund left by her biological father and teamed up with Julian Cross, a top-tier divorce lawyer for whom she once held unrequited feelings back in college. She launched a two-front counterattack, fighting relentlessly both at the child custody hearing and in the boardroom takeover battle.

shortPlayName: The Mechanic I Married Owns Manhattan
summary:
Single mother Clara Bennett flees her controlling ex-husband Derek with her five-year-old daughter Lily. Stranded by a broken car on a rainy night in a small town, she meets mechanic Mason Hale, who shelters them and defends her with the words: “Then stay. Tonight, nobody takes you back.”
Believing him to be a humble, reliable small-town mechanic, Clara enters a temporary marriage with Mason to fight for her daughter’s custody. At the custody hearing, Derek mocks Mason for having no status or wealth.
Mason’s legal team and corporate representatives then arrive, revealing he owns the largest debt claim against Derek’s company. Clara finally discovers her ordinary mechanic husband is the hidden heir of a Manhattan real estate group. Their sweet love story is built on sincere respect, constant protection, devoted companionship and resolute action.

shortPlayName: The Foster Son of the Iron Crown
summary:
Do you think he’s just a pitiful adopted son trampled in the mud?
No — he secured his trump card fifteen years ago.
Ethan lived and slept in the stables for fifteen years, used as a mounting block and tormented by the Duke’s legitimate son. Everyone saw him as a powerless nobody. But he kept a bronze crow ring, led a powerful underground merchant syndicate, and carried a twenty-five-year-old blood oath. His birth father was the Empire’s greatest commander, while the Duke was the deserter who abandoned him.
When the tyrant’s son tried to kill him with poisoned wine, Ethan dropped his meek facade. He reclaimed his family name, reformed the duchy’s finances, gained miners’ support and rebuilt the fallen Spine of the Dragon Legion. To his surprise, the Duke’s daughter, who once snuck food to him, grew into his most trusted aide.
The wolf who hid for fifteen years has shown his fangs. All players on the Empire’s chessboard finally discover: he has always been the master of the game.

summary:
Former elite CIA agent Morrison, crippled by PTSD, lives anonymously as a small-town farmer with his teen daughter Vivian. The Rosetti crime family craves his land; their young heir Theodore abducts and tortures 17-year-old Vivian to death to break him.
Grief-stricken, Morrison stops his PTSD meds, digs up his decade-hidden weapons, and marches alone to the Rosetti estate for revenge. Top cops, city officials and CIA brass remember his deadly combat skills. They order a full town evacuation and step back, letting him annihilate the whole syndicate.
This brutal blood-for-blood vendetta explores paternal love, trauma, systemic corruption and unhinged vengeance, blending past wartime ghosts with present ruin to depict an inevitable, merciless reckoning.

summary: On her wedding day, Eleanor Vance expects to step into the bridal Rolls-Royce. Instead, her fiancé Julian orders her into a cramped backup SUV so his “carsick” secretary Sophia can ride beside him. Humiliated in front of guests and filmed by jealous coworkers, Eleanor refuses to break. When a staged car accident keeps her from the ceremony, Sophia steals her gown, her aisle, and Julian’s kiss. But Eleanor has one card left: Christian Thorne, her childhood best friend and the powerful heir who has loved her for years. Within an hour, Eleanor and Christian are legally married. Then they return to the reception with a marriage certificate and a smile. Julian thinks he can still control the bride he discarded. He has no idea she is done begging for respect. This time, Eleanor is upgrading more than her ride—she is upgrading her whole life forever, and destroying his empire too.

summary:
Charlotte gave Damian eight years of love, loyalty, and sacrifice. She built their home, supported his career, and waited patiently while he became a successful VP. But when Damian started protecting his young intern Chloe again and again, Charlotte finally realized she had been the only one fighting for their future.
After Chloe deliberately sabotages a major corporate contract, Damian frames Charlotte to save her, even trying to send his own fiancée to prison. But Charlotte is no longer the woman who begs for love. With hidden recordings, recovered evidence, and a ruthless calm, she exposes their betrayal and sends both of them crashing down.
As Damian loses his career, his home, his freedom, and eventually his arm, Charlotte walks away without looking back. This time, she does not forgive. She takes everything back — her name, her life, and her power.

summary:

Mu Yao, a goddess who adores Qing Chen, ceaselessly schemes against Fusheng. To protect Fusheng, Qing Chen is forced to marry Mu Yao, yet he cannot ward off her relentless malice. Jing Yuan reveals his true form as a black dragon and withstands the heavenly tribulation for Fusheng; the two plunge together into the Seal of Love and enter the cycle of reincarnation. Years later, Qing Chen finds them, and the three join forces to combat Mu Yao, who has been utterly consumed by her desires and now brings havoc upon the Three Realms.

He has no memory of who he is. She does. The most dangerous man in the city becomes a servant in her family’s workshop, falling for the very woman guarding his second life. Meanwhile, his brother and fiancée celebrate his “death”—the secret behind it buried in blood and betrayal. As memories return and assassins close in, love and revenge collide. In a world of lies, truth is the most dangerous chain.

Leo Moore comes down from Dragonridge to serve as Ava Quinn’s personal bodyguard, only to be pulled into a power struggle within her family business and a battle against the Frost family and foreign forces coveting the Genesis System.

summary:
This is an inspiring story about mutual healing and growth between Lin Zeyan, a sensitive and withdrawn man traumatized by an eye injury, and Xia You, his warm, positive housekeeper.
Plagued by his eye condition, Lin Zeyan grows pessimistic and closes himself off from the world. But Xia You’s bright, resilient outlook gradually reignites his passion for life and career. Xia You, meanwhile, comes from a complicated family background. Despite life’s hardships, she has always kept a strong, lively spirit. As she spends time with Lin Zeyan, she finds the courage to pursue her own life purpose and self-worth. Life has no probationary period, nor any fixed limits. Through constant trial and error, every character in the story completes their own growth and transformation.
